vibe_rationale: Printed-art fair with exhibitions, launches, talks and concerts in Chile's national design month; curated, creative and close to SURPLUS's marketplace and zine strand.
fit_notes: Creative, adult print and design community with weak wellness adjacency and no health precedent recorded. Hosted by a university, with several partners and media, but no partnership page or contact published. Exhibitor tables from CLP 150,000 with free public entry make it a low-cost entry. A commissioned print or zine collaboration would land better than signage. Chile-based, so activation would need a local partner.
